debates.title: Shipments recovered much faster than end-sales
debates.analyst_question: TD Cowen: What inventory level is intended? Wolfe: why high Ram stock and discounts?
debates.management_answer: Inventory was built for launches, expected demand and summer shutdowns; June US stock~390k, July expectation~365k.
debates.our_read: NA shipments+38% versus sales+6% is not38% household-demand growth. US stock92days and+43%YoY make inventory a core debate. Build explanation is plausible but does not establish subsequent sell-through.
debates.next_discriminating_evidence: Actual stock reduction by family/age with retail sales and net pricing; match stock scope before exact reconciliation.

debates.title: Operating leverage is much weaker than the shipment headline
debates.analyst_question: Oxcap, Kepler and Goldman: why only1.6% NA margin with strong shipments/truck mix? Goldman cites27%→8% volume/mix drop-through.
debates.management_answer: Cost and quality gaps; final answer acknowledges nameplate mix and more Mexico-built shipments.
debates.our_read: Q2 NA volume/mix+409m and industrial+603m were partly absorbed by pricing−59m,SG&A−158m,R&D−101m. Earlier answers do not fully quantify the weak contribution. Do not treat analyst drop-through as a clean marginal plant-profit coefficient.
debates.next_discriminating_evidence: Contribution by nameplate/channel; detailed industrial bridge and comparable-quarter mix.
debates.forecast_line: Incremental unit contribution, mix, recurring costs and overhead

debates.title: VCP delivery versus savings retained
debates.analyst_question: ODDO: how much of€2.4bn is reinvested in pricing? What depends on utilization?
debates.management_answer: CFO expects all€2.4bn to flow to AOI; purchasing/materials and warranty opportunity much larger than utilization.
debates.our_read: This is a meaningful testable commitment, not evidence already earned. Competitive pressure, validation, supplier capacity and implementation costs can reduce realized benefit.
debates.next_discriminating_evidence: Identified implemented projects, recurring euros by region, net price and warranty outcomes; no cost-review count as profit.
debates.forecast_line: 2027/28 phased VCP; separate headwinds and utilization

debates.title: The€1.917bn Q2 industrial benefit is not a clean VCP number
debates.analyst_question: Oxcap: can the H1 industrial cost run rate be extrapolated?
debates.management_answer: About€1.4bn combines purchasing savings and warranty; warranty mainly benefits from nonrepeat European recall costs. Also manufacturing/logistics and regulatory effects.
debates.our_read: Europe had€474m nonrepeat recall cost in the comparison. Exact purchasing-versus-warranty split is not disclosed. Repeating€1.917bn×4 as recurring annual VCP is invalid.
debates.next_discriminating_evidence: Bridge recurring procurement/technical savings, comparison effects, actual claim costs and regulations separately.
debates.forecast_line: Cost normalization versus true recurring savings

debates.title: 2027 earnings must improve before the major volume launches mature
debates.analyst_question: JPMorgan: which new products lift utilization? TD Cowen: what growth is needed for2027 positive cash flow?
debates.management_answer: High-volume products arrive late2027/2028;2027 cash recovery mainly earnings from industrial efficiencies, with reasonable volume growth.
debates.our_read: 2027 cannot rely on mature2028 pickup volumes. More of its burden falls on existing products and cost execution; new launches require cash before steady production.
debates.next_discriminating_evidence: Model-specific starts, salable dealer arrivals, ramp volumes and implementation timing.

debates.title: Ram and Chrysler account for most planned brand growth
debates.analyst_question: What is the product-level source of the35% ambition?
debates.our_read: Derived: Ram+Chrysler supply about79% of the increase. This is expansion into new offers, not merely restoring old Jeep sales. Chrysler has less proven new-segment execution.
debates.next_discriminating_evidence: Pickups/SUV/van and affordable crossover launch economics; segment capture and cannibalization.
debates.forecast_line: Brand/family2028 volumes; use2030 endpoints only as constraints

debates.title: Affordable volume and profitable mix can conflict
debates.analyst_question: Wolfe and Goldman: what improves mix/pricing when current discounts and negative pricing are evident?
debates.management_answer: H2 rental mix improves seasonally, SRT helps, and industry inflation supports pricing; Q2 Mexico nameplate mix affected profit conversion.
debates.our_read: NA net-price bridge was+182m inQ1 derived fromH1 minusQ2, then−59m inQ2. Cheaper products can add profitable units but lower average revenue/margin; halo products cannot simply offset this without volumes and euro contribution.
debates.next_discriminating_evidence: Same-model net price, finance support, fleet share and achieved SRT/affordable trim mix.
debates.forecast_line: Keep price, model mix, channel mix and country/FX separate

debates.title: Cherokee is a concrete cost→mix→volume bottleneck
debates.analyst_question: Jefferies: production problem, poor economics or Mexico tariffs? When Belvidere?
debates.management_answer: Management claims strong funnel interest, restricts trims/channels to protect profitability, applies VCP, plans more competitive trims inH12027 and localization; no plant date provided.
debates.our_read: Strong mechanism evidence that restricted offers need not equal absence of interest. But funnel interest is an unquantified management claim, not independently proven deposits or demand. This is newCherokee, not Grand Cherokee4xe.
debates.next_discriminating_evidence: Achieved price/cost and stocked trims, dated localization, conversion/deposits/cancellations and net retail growth.
debates.forecast_line: Cherokee units, net price, landed cost and tariff exposure

debates.title: Quality improvement must become lower economic cost
debates.source: ID p9; Q2 pp5,29–32; FIN p34; CALL pp8–10
debates.analyst_question: Kepler: how much margin weakness is quality versus cost and channel?
debates.management_answer: Early-service quality improving; warranty and campaign costs remain a key opportunity.
debates.our_read: ID44% NA3MIS improvement usesJan–Oct2025 production; Q2 figure38% usesJan–Dec2025. Cannot call this six-point deterioration without comparable cohorts. Warranty reset/reserve effects and new defects differ.
debates.next_discriminating_evidence: Absolute claim rates, comparable cohorts/repair severity, mature warranty cash, recall costs included/excluded fromAOI.
debates.forecast_line: Warranty benefit counted once within VCP; no proportional44% expense haircut

debates.title: European growth can dilute mix and still add profit
debates.analyst_question: Jefferies: why negative mix with Leapmotor growth; can lower-priced cars still add earnings?
debates.management_answer: Leapmotor vehicles profitable but mix-dilutive; new products expected to raise contribution.
debates.our_read: European regional shipments+5% with nearly flat revenue, pricing bridge−617m and AOI−94m show volume alone is insufficient. US-focused work cannot explain the consolidated profit target by itself.
debates.next_discriminating_evidence: European net pricing, powertrain and distribution margins, JV/minority scope; total AOI and per-unit economics.
debates.forecast_line: Separate EE revenue/mix/cost forecast; avoid double counting partner sales and ownership

debates.title: Cash improvement partly reflects investment timing
debates.analyst_question: Deutsche/Goldman: Q3 working capital and apparent hugeH2 investment increase?
debates.management_answer: Capex rises inH2; CFO saysH1 total investment6.3% of revenue and analyst missed spending scope.
debates.our_read: Q2 IFCF+969mYoY alongside+814m lower capital outflow and+549m working-capital benefit. These are bridge components, not causalshares; other items offset.3497+1669≈5166m reconciles6.3%H1.
debates.next_discriminating_evidence: Cash investment schedule and R&D accounting; repeating cash benefits and inventory quality.
debates.forecast_line: Capex/R&D/D&A, cash conversion and debt financing

debates.title: Trade and regulatory assumptions are part of the plan
debates.source: FIN pp15,24; Q2 pp17,29–32; CALL pp9–13
debates.analyst_question: What happens if inflation, tariffs or regulation changes?
debates.management_answer: 2026net tariff cost€1.0–1.2bn; plan assumes favorable/stable framework and regulatory savings offset tariff increases within2028 bridge.
debates.our_read: This is not entirely controllable execution.€317m regulatory commitment gain is excluded fromQ2AOI; do not count it again as VCP or assume all regulatory gains are treated alike.
debates.next_discriminating_evidence: Actual tariff/refund treatment, sourcing, input contracts and enacted policies; forecasts labeled scenarios.
debates.forecast_line: Separate raw-material, tariff, regulatory and FX lines

debates.title: AOI recovery is not equivalent to EPS recovery
debates.analyst_question: What must be modeled below operating performance?
debates.management_answer: Deck reports AOI+263% but adjustedEPS€0.12 versus€0.15; hybrid coupons/tax effects enter EPS deduction.
debates.our_read: Need interest, tax, minorities and hybrid claims; historical impairments may lower future D&A but size attributable to resets is not isolated here. Do not credit all accounting change as operational VCP.
debates.next_discriminating_evidence: Consistent industrial/finance perimeter, tax normalization, debt/hybrid costs, depreciation schedules and adjustments.

debates.title: Platform and finance initiatives add opportunities and overlap
debates.analyst_question: Which additional initiatives deserve an independent forecast assumption?
debates.management_answer: STLAOne cost reduction, e-car2028, capacity changes, captive funding/penetration, software and partnerships.
debates.our_read: Component commonality may already beVCP. E-car and vans need individual ramp/cost tests. Captive finance is a separate credit/funding business. Robotaxi/software announcements do not yet justify material2028 standalone profit.
debates.next_discriminating_evidence: Per-platform applied volumes and unit cost; finance spread/losses and realized distributions; contracted tech revenue.
debates.forecast_line: Initiative-specific allocation; no overlapping savings or speculative profit plugs

A2027 benefit relative to2025 cannot automatically be added in full to2026 earnings: subtract the recurring benefit already present.
Use launch-year sales ramps, not2030maturevolume scaled linearly.
